toolObservationsReported: tools/trace-answers.py prints its summary comment with no preceding newline, so '# 727 tokens: ...' is concatenated onto the last record line. Cosmetic; reported rather than fixed because a sibling agent is in tools/ this iteration.

queue_status treats IN PROGRESS as contradicting an assertion that a task is open. That is the right rule - a task being worked this iteration will be stale by the time a reader reads - and it fired correctly here on a first draft that wrote 'T-139 is open'; the fix was the wording, which is also the more accurate one ('in flight').
Neither half of the tracer can see a file that contradicts ITSELF. The T-45 instance was SECTION 1 and SECTION 3 of ANSWERS.md disagreeing, with both halves individually traceable to the corpus.
